title: Vividly Charred Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Indulgent Argentinian dish featuring dried red chillies and pressure-cooked beef, cooked to perfection on a tava-griddle, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the tava-griddle over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, crushed chillies, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and mix until they are evenly coated with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Pressure-cook the beef strips for 10 minutes to tenderize them.
Remove the beef from the pressure cooker and place the skewers on the preheated tava-griddle.
Cook the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they are vividly charred.
Serve the charred beef skewers hot, garnished with lemongrass if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Slice the skewers into individual portions and serve immediately.
